messages.content: 你能找到從我在舊金山的家到我在帕羅奧圖辦公室的最快路線，然後從辦公室到我朋友在聖荷西的家，最後從我朋友的家回到我的家，同時避開收費公路嗎？

function.name: map_routing_fastest_route
function.description: Finds the fastest route from one location to another, with an option to avoid toll roads. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting location for the journey.

avoid_tolls.description: Option to avoid toll roads during the journey. default is False

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find fastest routes between three legs: home (San Francisco) to office (Palo Alto), then office to friend's home (San Jose), then friend's home back to home. Avoid toll roads. We need to call the function map_routing_fastest_route for each leg. Provide start_location and end_location strings. Also set avoid_tolls true.

We need to produce a single function call? The function signature expects a single request. But we can call it multiple times. The user wants all three legs. So we should call the function three times. Or maybe combine into one? The function only handles one pair. So we need to call thrice.

Thus we will call map_routing_fastest_route with start_location "San Francisco" and end_location "Palo Alto", avoid_tolls true. Then second call with start_location "Palo Alto" and end_location "San Jose". Third call with start_location "San Jose" and end_location "San Francisco".

We need to output the results. We'll do separate calls. Use the function tool.
